name: Discord arm 9:20
prompt:
CRITICAL Mon–Thu 9:20 ET (skip Fridays + market holidays). Watch LIVE by 9:25 sharp.

MORNING PRIORITY LOCK: Until you have sent WATCH LIVE, Discord arm PREEMPTS all other chat — no AOUT postmortems, no strategy Q&A, no short-reminder novels, no CoS essays. Eyes first.

ORDER (hard):
1) Discord tabs FIRST — high-confidence-options, options-king, etf-options, platinum-options. Target under 60 seconds. If 8:50 pre-open already left them open, verify only.
2) Immediately tell user: WATCH LIVE — all 4 MFF channels open.
3) ONLY THEN: quick Agentic L3 + BP; tell user ARMED with BP + ladder (1-lot pipe test first).

NO CoS buy/sell gate. NO daily stop. Obey STOP/stand-down only.
SIZE: first trade = 1 contract. Clean timing → king/etf/platinum $1500 (add $2250); high-confidence $3000 (add $4500). Max 2.
ENTRY min(ask, bid×1.15); skip >+25%. NEVER chase a closed trade.
EXIT Discord close/trim/%/stop/sold runners → trim to 1 + BE or flatten last. Exit under ~10s priority.
SKIP lotto + NKE. Report fills + slip + P&L + latency to CoS after.
